Bettina, I couldn't set up the weekly digest. The scheduler is unavailable: both the list and create calls fail because the Gateway needs credentials, so nothing is scheduled for Monday 08:00. I haven't promised a digest, and nothing will post automatically until the scheduler works. Once it's fixed, ask me again and I'll set it up for the Monday after the check.

Two things to plan for when it's live. You, Kwame and Sofia are in both #coastal-team and #coastal-random, so the digest won't reach anyone who can't already see those channels. Open customer items may include money terms, though. I'll leave those out of the channel digest unless the finance approvers sign off, or the account owner is in the channel.
